BaggageItemDoc.title: BaggageItemDoc
BaggageItemDoc.description: Represents a luggage item in the user's dynamic baggage manifest (AI-scanned or manually entered).

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user owning this item.

name.description: Display name of the luggage item.

weightGrams.description: Weight of the item in grams (e.g., 2150 for 2.15 kg).

isShiftedToPersonal.description: Whether the item has been shifted to the personal bag buffer.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was created (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was last updated (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/baggage_items/{itemId}.description: Per-user subcollection storing the user's baggage manifest items.
